name: null-unreal
description: Unreal Engine project tooling for Null IDE: build, test, run and smoke from the status bar, the command palette and a terminal CLI (Windows, experimental)

null-unreal.enginePath.description: Unreal Engine root folder (the one that contains Engine\). Overrides EngineAssociation resolution.

null-unreal.project.description: The .uproject to use when the folder holds more than one.

null-unreal.build.args.description: Extra arguments appended to the build command.

null-unreal.test.args.description: Extra arguments appended to the test command.

null-unreal.run.args.description: Extra arguments appended to the run command.

null-unreal.export.args.description: Extra arguments appended to the engine command line of an asset export.

null-unreal.smoke.args.description: Extra arguments appended to the smoke command.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test out/uproject.test.js out/engine.test.js out/commandLine.test.js out/logs.test.js out/runner.test.js out/result.test.js out/cli.test.js out/shim.test.js out/exportFormat.test.js out/packagePath.test.js out/cache.test.js out/lock.test.js out/exporter.test.js out/assetStore.test.js
